title: ASDSO / DamFailures.org as dam-failure case memory and lesson-synthesis rail
summary: ASDSO/DamFailures.org is encoded as professional case-memory infrastructure: it aggregates dam failure and incident case studies and lesson pages so recurring dam-safety patterns can be found before and after investigations.

status_history.note: Added as rev0026 impoundment/tailings correction rail.

subjects.name: Association of State Dam Safety Officials

claims.claim: DamFailures.org says it has over 50 dam failure/incident case studies and lesson pages that synthesize lessons across multiple failures and incidents.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

claims.claim: The ASDSO Teton entry shows how the same infrastructure surfaces case-level consequence memory, listing the Teton failure date, deaths, and property damage.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

claims.claim: The DamFailures.org lesson page records references and peer review by named dam-safety professionals, which makes it a professional learning rail but not a substitute for primary investigation reports.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

type_payload.signal_capture_model: case-study aggregation, lesson pages, professional peer review, resource links
type_payload.outputs: case studies, lesson-learned pages, references, videos/resources, professional learning materials
type_payload.limitations: Not an official regulator or investigator for every case; source quality varies by case; should be paired with primary reports where possible.

handling_notes: Infrastructure records are correction rails, not guarantees of correction or safety.
Avoid implying that standards, portals, or case-study sites replace regulatory authority, engineering judgment, community consent, or emergency preparedness.

unknowns: Coverage completeness and update cadence not yet audited.
No comparison yet with National Performance of Dams Program or FEMA National Dam Safety Program source rails.
next_actions: Map ASDSO case entries to primary reports and official investigation records.
Add National Performance of Dams Program and FEMA/USACE/CISA dam-safety rails in a future pass.
